item.description: Today, during the Final Fantasy XIV Letter from the Producer Live 90, gameplay and information about update 7.4 have been revealed.

item.title: The HDR Gaming Interview - Veteran Dev Explains Its Sad State and How He's Coming to Its Rescue
item.description: Wccftech interviewed Remedy graphics programmer Filippo Tarpini to discuss the sad state of HDR gaming and his tireless efforts to improve it.

item.title: Axis Football 26 review - ChristCenteredGamer
item.description: CCG writes - "The best way I believe to describe the gameplay of Axis Football is like a remastered Madden game from the 2000s, the graphics and mechanics are that far behind. However, keeping the graphics the way they are enables the live game-play to be more realistic and fun. Is Axis Football's Franchise Mode really the best in the business? item.title: EA adds eight new patents to industry-first accessibility patent pledge
item.description: Electronic Arts celebrates five years of its industry-first accessibility patent pledge by adding eight more patents, reinforcing its commitment to accessible gaming.

item.title: Samson: A Tyndalston Story Is a Game Where the Protagonist Is Fighting His Way Out of Debt
item.description: Liquid Swords has unveiled Samson: A Tyndalston Story, a brutal open world game where the protagonist desperately tries to get out of debt.

item.title: Goonswarm reveals new game, cancels it, then closes studio after accusations of using AI generation
item.description: Postal: Bullet Paradise developers Goonswarm have fiercely denied the accusations that they used generative AI to create elements of the game... and announced that they are closing down.

item.title: SLEEP AWAKE first impressions: Bite-sized nightmares | The Escapist
item.description: SLEEP AWAKE is an unnerving, psychedelic horror experience from the teams at EYES OUT and Blumhouse Games. Exploring what would happen to humans if they were unable to sleep, playing through SLEEP AWAKE felt like wandering through a nightmarish art exhibit.

item.title: How to God Review A Divine Sandbox | XRSource
item.description: Ever wanted to be worshipped like a god? That means you'll need a god-simulator of which there aren't many in VR. Thankfully, Thoughtfish decided to rectify this by releasing How to God for Meta Quest.

item.title: PS5, EA Sports FC 26 and Hogwarts Legacy come out top during Europes Black Friday
item.description: There wasnt a single new release in the European Top 20 last week, but there was a surge in sales across the board due to the Black Friday sales week.

item.title: Yes, Netflix is acquiring Warner Bros. Games
item.description: A Warner Bros. spokesperson has confirmed the video game division will be acquired by Netflix alongside its wider streaming and television business.
